Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF :fixed_site_slots.site_id is NOT NULL THEN
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_summary','E');
END IF;

IF :fixed_site_slots.site_id is NOT NULL AND :ctrl_blk_1.summary_flag = 'N' THEN
 declare
 cursor c1 is select Initcap(first_name)||' '||Initcap(last_name) name
 from donor_schedule
 where site_id = :fixed_site_slots.site_id 
 AND sch_from_time = :fixed_site_slots.time_of_day
 AND donation_type = nvl(:fixed_site_slots.donation_type_group,donation_type)
 AND proc_code = nvl(:fixed_site_slots.proc_code,proc_code)
 AND status = 'CNFRM'
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 begin
 go_block('donor_schedule');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 :donor_schedule.name := c1rec.name;
 if c1%notfound then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 first_record; 
 go_block('fixed_site_slots');
 end;
END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;
BEGIN
 :system.message_level := '10';
 /*set_window_property('window_show',
 title,
 '[ ' || ' DSWASLOT' || ' 1.01.05 ]'||
 ' Donation Slots ' ); --|| :parameter.p_drive_id); */
 /*set_window_property('window_show',-- commented 5307
 title, ' DSWASLOT' || ' [Ver: 01 ]'||
 ' Donation Slots ' ); */ --|| :parameter.p_drive_id);
 -- [Ver: 03 ] -- 5307 Julius 4/28/11*/
 -- [Ver: 03 ] -- IM 5307 */
 -- [Ver: 04 ] -- SCR 18384
 -- [Ver: 05 ] -- IM 8497
 -- [Ver: 06 ] -- Removed Duplicate Objects
 
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 
 set_window_property('window_show',
 title, ' DSWASLOT' || ' [Ver: 01 ]'||
 ' Donation Slots ' ); 
 
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);

 else

 end if;
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_DATE := v_local_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.from_day := to_char(v_local_date, 'DY');

 END IF;

 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.SLOT_DATE is not null THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_DATE := to_date(:Parameter.SLOT_DATE,'MMDDRR');
 :ctrl_blk_1.from_day := to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.s_date, 'DY');
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.END_DATE is not null THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.E_DATE := to_date(:Parameter.END_DATE,'MMDDRR');
 :ctrl_blk_1.to_day := to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.e_date, 'DY');
 else

 :ctrl_blk_1.to_day := to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.e_date, 'DY');
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.LOCATION is not null THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.LOCATION := :Parameter.LOCATION; 
 END IF; 
 -----------------------------------------
 IF :PARAMETER.SLOT_DATE is not null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_date');

 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.END_DATE is not null THEN

 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.DON_TYPE is not null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.S_DON');
 validate(item_scope);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.PROC_CODE is not null THEN

 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.location');
 validate(item_scope);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ----------------------------
 :ctrl_blk_1.summary_flag := 'N';
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_summary','D');
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.location is not null
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_don is not null
 and :ctrl_blk_1.procedure_code is not null 
 THEN
 go_block('fixed_site_slots');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 where_clause varchar2(1000);
 v_from varchar2(30);
 v_to varchar2(30);
v_clause varchar2(100);
v_clause1 varchar2(100);
v_clause2 varchar2(100);
v_clause3 varchar2(100);
v_clause4 varchar2(100);
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;
BEGIN
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time; 
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 IF :Ctrl_blk_1.s_date is null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_date := trunc(v_local_date);
 END IF; 
IF :ctrl_blk_1.e_date is null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.e_date := :ctrl_blk_1.s_date + 6;
END IF;
if :ctrl_blk_1.from_time is not null and :ctrl_blk_1.to_time is not null then
v_from := to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.s_date, 'mm-dd-rr')||' '||to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.from_time, 'hh24:mi');
v_to := to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.e_date, 'mm-dd-rr')||' '||to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.to_time, 'hh24:mi');
:ctrl_blk_1.dummy_from := to_date(v_from, 'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
:ctrl_blk_1.dummy_to := to_date(v_to, 'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
--message('1'||to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.dummy_from)); pause;
--message('2'||to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.dummy_to)); pause;
end if;
where_clause := ' site_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.location,site_id) and '||
 ' donation_type_group = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_don, donation_type_group) and'||
 ' proc_code = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.procedure_code,proc_code) and '||
 ' sch_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_date and :ctrl_blk_1.e_date '||
 ' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
if :ctrl_blk_1.from_time is not null and :ctrl_blk_1.to_time is not null then
 where_clause := where_clause || ' and time_of_day between :ctrl_blk_1.dummy_from and :ctrl_blk_1.dummy_to ';
end if;
if :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'BOOK' then
 where_clause := where_clause ||' and nvl(booked_slots, 0) > 0 and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0))<= 0 ';

elsif :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'AVL' then
 where_clause := where_clause ||' and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0)) > 0 and nvl(booked_slots, 0)= 0 ';

elsif :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'ALL' then
 where_clause := where_clause;

elsif :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'PAR' then
 where_clause := where_clause ||' and booked_slots > 0 and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0))> 0 ';

elsif :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'FPAR' then
 where_clause := where_clause || ' and ((nvl(booked_slots, 0) > 0 and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0))<= 0) or (nvl(booked_slots, 0) > 0 and max_slots-booked_slots > 0)) '; 

end if;

IF :ctrl_blk_1.summary_flag = 'N' THEN

 go_block('fixed_site_slots');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :system.message_level := 5;
 set_block_property('fixed_site_slots', default_where, where_clause);
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 first_record;
 --IF :fixed_site_slots.s_time_of_day is null THEN -- Commented by Kishore on 08/17/2011. SCR 18384
 IF :fixed_site_slots.time_of_day is null THEN -- Added by Kishore on 08/17/2011. SCR 18384
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 show_error('11091');
 END IF;
END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_1

PROCEDURE DO_RETRIEVE_1 IS
CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP, 
 SUM(MAX_SLOTS) MAX_SLOTS, SUM(BOOKED_SLOTS) BOOKED_SLOTS 
 FROM FIXED_SITE_SLOTS 
 WHERE site_id = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.location,site_id) 
 and donation_type_group = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.s_don, donation_type_group) 
 and proc_code = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.procedure_code,proc_code) 
 and sch_date between :CTRL_BLK_1.s_date and :CTRL_BLK_1.e_date 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 GROUP BY SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP ;
CURSOR C2 IS
 SELECT SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP, 
 SUM(MAX_SLOTS) MAX_SLOTS, SUM(BOOKED_SLOTS) BOOKED_SLOTS 
 FROM FIXED_SITE_SLOTS 
 WHERE site_id = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.location,site_id) 
 and donation_type_group = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.s_don, donation_type_group) 
 and proc_code = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.procedure_code,proc_code) 
 and sch_date between :CTRL_BLK_1.s_date and :CTRL_BLK_1.e_date 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID 
 and nvl(booked_slots, 0) > 0 and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0))<= 0 
 GROUP BY SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP ;

CURSOR C3 IS
 SELECT SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP, 
 SUM(MAX_SLOTS) MAX_SLOTS, SUM(BOOKED_SLOTS) BOOKED_SLOTS 
 FROM FIXED_SITE_SLOTS 
 WHERE site_id = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.location,site_id) 
 and donation_type_group = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.s_don, donation_type_group) 
 and proc_code = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.procedure_code,proc_code) 
 and sch_date between :CTRL_BLK_1.s_date and :CTRL_BLK_1.e_date 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID 
 and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0)) > 0 and nvl(booked_slots, 0)= 0 
 GROUP BY SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP ;

CURSOR C4 IS
 SELECT SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP, 
 SUM(MAX_SLOTS) MAX_SLOTS, SUM(BOOKED_SLOTS) BOOKED_SLOTS 
 FROM FIXED_SITE_SLOTS 
 WHERE site_id = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.location,site_id) 
 and donation_type_group = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.s_don, donation_type_group) 
 and proc_code = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.procedure_code,proc_code) 
 and sch_date between :CTRL_BLK_1.s_date and :CTRL_BLK_1.e_date 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID 
 and booked_slots > 0 and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0))> 0
 GROUP BY SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP ;

CURSOR C5 IS
 SELECT SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP, 
 SUM(MAX_SLOTS) MAX_SLOTS, SUM(BOOKED_SLOTS) BOOKED_SLOTS 
 FROM FIXED_SITE_SLOTS 
 WHERE site_id = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.location,site_id) 
 and donation_type_group = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.s_don, donation_type_group) 
 and proc_code = nvl(:CTRL_BLK_1.procedure_code,proc_code) 
 and sch_date between :CTRL_BLK_1.s_date and :CTRL_BLK_1.e_date 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID 
 and ((nvl(booked_slots, 0) > 0 and (max_slots-nvl(booked_slots, 0))<= 0) or (nvl(booked_slots, 0) > 0 and max_slots-booked_slots > 0)) 
 GROUP BY SITE_ID, SCH_DATE, PROC_CODE, DONATION_TYPE_GROUP ;

BEGIN
if :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'BOOK' then
 go_block('fixed_site_slots1');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record;

 :fixed_site_slots1.proc_code := c2rec.proc_code;

 :fixed_site_slots1.max_slots := c2rec.max_slots;
 :fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots := c2rec.booked_slots;
 setcolor;

 end loop;
 first_record;
elsif :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'AVL' then

elsif :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'PAR' then

 end loop;
 first_record;
elsif :ctrl_blk_1.select_slot = 'FPAR' then

 for c5rec in c5 loop

ProgramUnit.Name: SETCOLOR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE setcolor IS
BEGIN
 begin
:fixed_site_slots1.day := :fixed_site_slots1.sch_date;

BEGIN
 SELECT location_name INTO :fixed_site_slots1.location_name
 FROM locations
 WHERE location_id = :fixed_site_slots1.site_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
END;
:fixed_site_slots1.avl := :fixed_site_slots1.max_slots - :fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots ;
if nvl(:fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots,0)> 0 and :fixed_site_slots1.avl <= 0 then
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.max_slots' , 'va_book');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots' , 'va_book');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.avl' , 'va_book');
elsif :fixed_site_slots1.avl != 0 and nvl(:fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots,0) = 0 then
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.max_slots' , 'va_avl');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots' , 'va_avl');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.avl' , 'va_avl');
elsif :fixed_site_slots1.avl > 0 and nvl(:fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots,0) != 0 then
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.max_slots' , 'va_par');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.booked_slots' , 'va_par');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots1.avl' , 'va_par');
end if;
end;

END;
